blurb: Guests can attend unlimited mat classes, Pilates equipment classes, private sessions, and specialty wellness services such as yoga therapy, brain health programs, and Ayurvedic treatments. The studio offers memberships, class passes, and private sessions with a focus on holistic health and personalized care. They also host retreats and professional training courses.
extraNote: Cancel mat classes up to 4 hours before to avoid fees; equipment classes up to 24 hours before · Late cancel and no-show fees apply to drop-in and 10-class packs; auto-monthly members incur fees after 2 late/no-shows · All memberships, packages and class bookings are non-refundable; cancellations credited to account · Private/small group appointments cancel up to 24-48 hours ahead for refund credit · No entry allowed after 5 minutes past class start time
